name: comp-584

frames.best_why: The search holds a typed query while both header rows are fully visible.

tagline: Two-row header with a command-K search box above a strip of section links.
summary: A dark site header whose top row has a logo, a centered search field with a shortcut hint, a bell and an avatar, plus a second row of Home, Features, Pricing and About links.
appearance: A two-row dark header: the top row has a starburst logo, a centered rounded search field with a magnifier and a small ⌘K hint, then a bell and avatar; a divider separates a second row of four nav links.
behaviour: Typing fills the search field with a query and a native clear button. Nav links brighten on hover, and the bell drops a notifications panel from the top right that overlaps the link row.
demo_content: The search example reads design system; links are Home, Features, Pricing and About; updates mention Chris Tompson.
search_phrases: header with search and secondary nav
search field with command k hint
top bar with notifications and avatar
header with keyboard shortcut in search
use_when: A site wants a prominent search plus a secondary row of section links.
avoid_when: The nav strip hides on mobile, and the search shows a ⌘K hint that is never actually bound.
customise: Search placeholder, nav labels, the active link and the ⌘K hint are written in the file; notification and user menus are separate pieces.
weight_why: Two rows of links, one input and two small menus.

a11y.note: The search field has no label beyond its placeholder, the logo link is unnamed, and ⌘K is decorative only.

issues: The ⌘K hint is displayed but no keyboard shortcut is wired up.
The open notifications panel covers the section link row.
polish_why: The two-tier header is well balanced; the shortcut hint is fake and the panel covers the nav.
title: Simple Nav Header
